title: 5th string: A, B and C
summary: Notes that sit on extra lines below the staff.

steps.title: Ledger lines
text: Notes lower than the staff sit on short extra lines called **ledger lines**.
**C** is on the first ledger line below the staff: the 3rd fret of the 5th string.

steps.title: B and A
text: **B** hangs just under that ledger line, at the 2nd fret. The open 5th string, **A**, sits on a second ledger line.

steps.title: Up and back
text: Open, 2nd finger, 3rd finger: the same shape as the 4th string.

steps.title: Across two strings
text: From the open 5th string up to F on the 4th, and back down.

steps.title: A, B and C
text: Four bars on the 5th and 4th strings.
